build_AllScAIP_backbone: build an AllScAIP backbone model with graph attention blocks and configurable transformer layers for molecular property prediction
create_AllScAIP_energy_head: create an AllScAIP energy head that computes per-atom energy outputs using a feedforward network and scatter reduction
create_AllScAIP_direct_force_head: create an AllScAIP direct force head that predicts atomic forces through a feedforward network on node representations
create_AllScAIP_gradient_energy_force_st: create an AllScAIP gradient-based head that computes energy, forces, and stress via autograd on energy outputs
validate_atoms_data_AllScAIPBackbone: validate ASE atoms data by setting default charge and spin values and checking they are within acceptable ranges
